body: Wave 2 integration and shipping, 2026-10-03 early hours.U+000AU+000AU+002D origin/main is def84d15, which holds #251 and #252. I merged it into each wave 2 branch with a merge commit each.U+000A  U+002D petals-waveform: 30cb0125, clean.U+000A  U+002D meadow: 92b5c5fd, clean.U+000A  U+002D onboarding: 1d28cd91, with a conflict in tour_chapter_test.dart. Git had paired wave 2's rewritten test with main's `_expectBarSelection` edit. I resolved it with --ours (the onboarding branch's rewrite), since that helper no longer exists there. The only remaining mutedDeep in the file is the dark subtitle check.U+000AU+002D Fix-ups:U+000A  U+002D meadow 2a7a2f90 test(meadow): read the phone summary and open the details sheet for the sprout tally (garden_sprouts_test, with a new `_openDetails` helper).U+000A  U+002D onboarding 4129485d test(onboarding): accept the 44-point phone toggle and Skip. The onboarding.txt baseline was re-recorded and gained exactly 28 lines, 17 'Switch to dark' and 11 'Skip', all bottom-bar states, with none removed. The notifications-off test now expects, unordered, the progress marks of the chapters before Reminder plus the toggle on the bottom bar, and nothing on the sidebar.U+000A  U+002D onboarding 984d4665 fix(onboarding): let Other ways scroll when its blocks cannot fit. In other_ways_panel.dart the Column of Expanded blocks moved inside CustomScrollView(ClampingScrollPhysics) > SliverFillRemaining(hasScrollBody: false). All 72 smallest-window cases pass, including o12 at 1.3, which failed before.U+000A  U+002D onboarding 74f1daa2 fix(onboarding): keep the soil to the bottom edge when the phone scene lifts for Mood. `clipBehavior: Clip.none` on the scene Stack in garden_scene.dart. New test test/features/onboarding/chapters/garden_soil_reach_test.dart samples the root layer: bottom-edge luminance was 0.748 (paper) with the old file and passes (under 0.3) with the fix. I proved it through a scratch-copy swap, not stash. The test uses TargetPlatformVariant.only(android).U+000A  U+002D onboarding 341796f0 refactor(onboarding): name the fixed cream and sage scene colours in the palette. token_cleanup_test's light-only hex rule flagged literal #FBF3E4 and #7D8450 in other_ways_panel.dart and onboarding_frame.dart, introduced by wave 2 Lane 2. The prototype hard-codes both as theme-independent, so Palette gained creamOnSoil and snapSage. The values are unchanged.U+000AU+002D All three suites pass (criterion 3 marked done).U+000AU+002D The local mitosis/proto-phone-shell was fast-forwarded in the wave 1 worktree from 19d9386f to origin/main def84d15. It is wave 2's --feature-branch, and its content is now in main, so reconcile and the gate measure wave 2 against main instead of reporting the main merge as stray writes.U+000AU+002D pr_adapter.py gained 'more', 'checks', 'risk' and extra not_verified entries for proto-meadow, proto-onboarding and proto-petals-waveform (the pre-edit copy is in the scratchpad as pr_adapter.before-wave2.py). Every field is 500 characters or less.U+000AU+002D `SHIP=1 run.zsh 2 --resume` was launched detached (pid in wave2-ship.pid, log wave2-ship.log; pre-ship state in the scratchpad as wave2-state-before-ship.json). The watch is Monitor bskakh530. The PRs open against main because mitosis/proto-phone-shell is not on origin.U+000AU+002D The temporary .claude/launch.json I added to the owner's checkout (prototype server on port 8765) is still there; remove it at the end.
